title: Joseph of Copertino's levitation records
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Joseph of Copertino's levitation records, about 17th century at Italy, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: have looked at so much data I mean I have the Joseph of copertino Records right yeah and been reading them and they're pretty intense

plain: A professor of religious studies, Diana Pasulka, says she has the records of Joseph of Copertino, a 17th-century Italian friar said to float in the air, and has been reading them. She calls them pretty intense and mentions the physicist Hal Puthoff while talking about how much data she has looked at. If the records are right, they would describe a person rising off the ground, witnessed and written down long ago.
